responsibility: Declares the CfgStrip visitor used by Rust macro expansion/preprocessing to apply conditional-compilation attributes to the AST. It exposes the crate entry point and helper routines for stripping or validating struct fields, tuple fields, parameters, generic arguments, where clauses, and many concrete AST node kinds, defining the public interface for the pass that removes nodes failing #[cfg] and expands cfg_attr before later compilation stages consume the tree.
same_name_distinction: Declares the CfgStrip pass API and its large set of visitor/maybe_strip entry points for use elsewhere in gcc/rust/expand. Unlike the paired implementation file, this header provides the class shape and callable interface, not the cfg evaluation, attr expansion, erasure, and diagnostic logic.
